title: Perturbation theory for estimated scores
statement: First-order reporting and rule-transfer bounds for frozen score rules are audited with corrections (SCORE-ERROR-RETENTION-BUDGET, SCORE-ERROR-RULE-TRANSFER; AUDIT-SCORE-ERROR-BUDGET-001). Remaining: uniform error control plus optimization-gap certification, D_s, refitted rules and sharp second-order constants. No uniform relative/log reporting bound follows from an L2 score-error upper bound alone without retention conditioning.
